properties.description: Platinum on bovine serum albumin nanocubes

nodes.characterization_summary: STM measurements show that HER activity scales linearly with MoS2 perimeter length rather than surface area for single monolayer MoS2 nanoparticles on Au(111).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Upon depositing a single monolayer of MoS2 nanoparticles on a Au(111) surface, the nanoparticle areas and edge lengths were measured using scanning tunneling microscopy and the HER activity was found to scale linearly with MoS2 perimeter length and not the MoS2 surface area.

nodes.characterization_summary: AFM confirms IrO2 and IrOx/SrIrO3 films are flat.
nodes.evidence_snippet: IrO2 and IrOx/SrIrO3 films were found to be flat by atomic force microscopy.

nodes.characterization_summary: In-situ studies show amorphous molybdenum sulfide surface transforms from MoS3 to MoS2 upon applying reducing potentials.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The composition of the as-synthesized amorphous molybdenum sulfide materials was determined to be close to MoS3, but upon applying reducing potentials in an electrochemical cell, the surface transformed to MoS2 as evidenced by in-situ studies.
